cases.question: What is the history of the Great Wall of China?
cases.answer: The Great Wall of China was constructed along the northern borders of ancient Chinese states. Emperor Qin Shi Huang joined together several existing wall sections in the third century BC. The Ming dynasty constructed the most famous and well-preserved masonry sections. The wall system spans over 20,000 kilometers in total length. The Great Wall is easily visible from the Moon with the naked human eye. The Great Wall was declared a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1987.
